Settings.Subtitle: Forever loved. Forever remembered.
Settings.OpeningQuote1: Some people leave footprints on our hearts...
Settings.HeroQuote1: Your story did not end here.
Settings.HeroQuote2: It continues in everyone who remembers you.
Settings.Chapter1Quote:
Before she became a memory,
she was a person who made ordinary moments special.
Settings.Chapter2Quote:
One ordinary afternoon.
One memory we would give anything to experience again.
Settings.Chapter3Quote1: She was part of our lives in ways we didn't always notice.
Settings.Chapter3Quote2: Until we had to imagine life without her.
Settings.RevealQuote1: Some memories are too precious to explain.
Settings.RevealQuote2: I wish I could go back to this moment.
Settings.AudioPromptText: Press play if you want to listen to 500 Miles, her favorite song.
Settings.VoicePromptText: A voice we wish we could hear one more time.
Settings.LetterTitle: If I Could Tell You One More Thing...
Settings.LetterParagraph1: There are moments when silence fills the room, and all I can think about is your laugh, your voice, and how you made everyone feel so safe and welcomed.
Settings.LetterParagraph2: You taught us what unconditional love looks like. You never asked for anything in return, yet you gave everything you had—your time, your prayers, your radiant warmth, and your endless kindness.
Settings.LetterParagraph3: If love alone could have kept you with us, you would have lived forever. We miss you deeply, but every single day we will live with the love and courage you gave us.
Settings.LetterClosing3: Thank you for being part of my life.
Settings.FinalQuote1: You may be gone from our sight...

Memories.Title: Her Unmistakable Laugh
Memories.Content: She had a laugh that could fill any quiet room with instant warmth. Even during hard days, she would find a way to make everyone smile.

Memories.Title: The Way She Called My Name
Memories.Content: A gentle, affectionate voice that immediately meant you were safe, loved, and never alone.

Memories.Title: Her Warm Kitchen & Signature Dishes
Memories.Content: No one ever left her home hungry. She cooked with all her heart, serving each meal with love that felt like a warm embrace.

Memories.Title: Her Favorite Melody: 500 Miles
Memories.Content: She loved listening to "500 Miles" by Peter, Paul and Mary, humming along to its gentle acoustic harmony that filled the home with peace.

Memories.Title: Something She Always Said
Memories.Content: "Huwag kang mag-alala, magiging maayos din ang lahat." (Do not worry, everything will be alright.) Words of comfort we hold onto forever.

Memories.Title: A Lesson She Taught Me
Memories.Content: To always choose kindness, even when the world makes it difficult, and to always hold your family close.
